sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scenes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scene_parts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "scene_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scenes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "order" REAL NOT NULL, "part_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("part_type" IN ('frame', 'resolver', 'custom')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "places" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_metadatas" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES places (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frames" ("scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scene_parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "background_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES background_metadatas (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scene_part_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scene_part_resolvers" ("scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scene_parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "dart_resolver_script" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scene_part_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_scene_parts" ("scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scene_parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scene_part_id"));

CREATE VIEW scene_timeline_view AS SELECT scene_parts.id, scene_parts.scene_id, scene_parts."order", scene_parts.part_type, frames.background_id, scene_part_resolvers.dart_resolver_script, custom_scene_parts.event_id FROM scene_parts LEFT OUTER JOIN frames ON frames.scene_part_id = scene_parts.id LEFT OUTER JOIN scene_part_resolvers ON scene_part_resolvers.scene_part_id = scene_parts.id LEFT OUTER JOIN custom_scene_parts ON custom_scene_parts.scene_part_id = scene_parts.id
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "actors" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pose_metadatas" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frame_poses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "frame_scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES frames (scene_part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pose_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES pose_metadatas (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "order" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE VIEW frame_poses_view AS SELECT frame_poses.id, frame_poses.frame_scene_part_id, frame_poses.pose_id, frame_poses."order", pose_metadatas.group_id, pose_metadatas.name FROM frame_poses LEFT OUTER JOIN pose_metadatas ON pose_metadatas.id = frame_poses.pose_id
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "choices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frame_choices" ("frame_scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES frames (scene_part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "choice_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES choices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("frame_scene_part_id"));
CREATE VIEW frame_choices_view AS SELECT frame_choices.frame_scene_part_id, frame_choices.choice_id, choices.name FROM frame_choices LEFT OUTER JOIN choices ON choices.id = frame_choices.choice_id
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_images" ("metadata_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES background_metadatas (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "image_data" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("metadata_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pose_images" ("metadata_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pose_metadatas (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "image_data" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("metadata_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "choice_options" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "choice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES choices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_selected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_selected" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dialogue_boxes" ("frame_scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES frames (scene_part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NULL, "dialogue" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("frame_scene_part_id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_selected_per_choice ON choice_options (choice_id) WHERE is_selected = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "resolver_choice_reference" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "resolver_scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scene_part_resolvers (scene_part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "choice_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES choices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "identifier" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "resolver_scene_part_reference" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "resolver_scene_part_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scene_part_resolvers (scene_part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scene_part_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES scene_parts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "identifier" TEXT NOT NULL);
